name: echo last supper
description: Proposal after Leonardo da Vinci, The Last Supper (about 1495 to 1498), 40 cell lattice (12 px cells): thirteen small ECHO creatures, each the family four cells wide with an antenna, a visor row whose ends are its eyes and feet under the table, sit behind a long white cloth in four groups of three (two in front, one behind and higher) round a middle one framed by the bright middle window, under an umber coffered ceiling with dark hangings down the side walls; the middle one pings, flings its arms straight out three cells each side and holds them, then lays them on the table, and a rolling bump of gestures runs out to both ends and back, the diner at its crest jumping two rows and either throwing its pale hands up or pinging with its eyes wide while its neighbours rise a row, then the arms come in and they all sit still; judge whether thirteen diners read at a glance as the painting, whether each still reads as this creature at four cells wide, and whether the bump reads as one wave rolling out and back.
